# Browser Remote Sync Protocol vendored source

brsp.js and vdo-ninja-transport.js are unmodified source files from
[GeorgeFejer91/browser-remote-sync-protocol](https://github.com/GeorgeFejer91/browser-remote-sync-protocol)
at commit e6a5eef86d4b3c7422ace08706df5deb82338808.

They are used for the bounded BRSP/1 QR quick-pair study-controller slice.
